resources.string: Checking the signature databases on the FortiSafe server…

The signature databases are up to date (version %1$s).

Could not reach the database server. The current databases were kept.
The database server gave an unexpected answer. The current databases were kept.
Update refused: the FortiSafe signature is missing or invalid. The current databases were kept.
Update refused: the database manifest is malformed. The current databases were kept.
Update refused: the server offered an older version than the installed one. The current databases were kept.
Update refused: the version on the server was revoked by FortiSafe.
Update refused: the databases on the server have expired. The current databases were kept.
Update refused: a downloaded file does not match the signed manifest. Nothing was changed.
Could not save the databases on this device. Nothing was changed.
Using signature databases version %1$s (published %2$s).
Attention: the signature databases are out of date (valid until %1$s). Update the databases.
Signature databases version %1$s were revoked by FortiSafe and are no longer used. Update the databases.
No valid signature databases are installed. Update the databases.
The installed file %1$s does not match the accepted manifest, so the databases were not loaded. Update the databases.
